card.name: Linking words before aseptic preparation conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as under, in, as per, using, or an that come after prepared, performed, or carried out and lead into a required setting, such as aseptic conditions, a hood, or good practice.

modes.label: Under conditions
modes.description: The word 'under' follows a preparation verb and introduces controlled conditions or supervision.
modes.example: The above process should be carried out<< under>> a laminar flow hood using ase

modes.label: In or per a setting
modes.description: A short linking word such as in, an, a, as per, or using introduces an appropriate setting, policy, or technique for preparation.
modes.example: ZEVASKYN is to be prepared by the manufacturer in<< an>> appropriate healthcare setting for surgical application by a

modes.label: Good Laboratory Practice bracket
modes.description: The opening parenthesis follows 'Good Laboratory Practice' just before the abbreviation GLP.
modes.example: in a study conducted under Good Laboratory Practice<< (>>GLP) and according to current recommended

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words such as Good, GL, and validation, which suggest a quality-standard phrase like Good Laboratory Practice.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes right before a required standard or condition for preparing a drug, such as aseptic conditions.
